_help: EVENTS & TOURNAMENTS. Copy one { ... } block to add an event, with a comma between blocks (not after the last). date must be YYYY-MM-DD. time is optional free text. link is optional (empty = Discord invite). Events are sorted by date and hidden automatically once the date has passed. The events below are SAMPLES: replace them with real ones.

events.title: HAZE Winter Clash
events.description: Duos Zero Build cash-cup style: five matches, points for placements and eliminations. Sign up with your duo in #events.

events.title: Box Fight Showdown
events.description: 1v1 box fights in a creative map, single elimination. Build fast, edit faster, and claim the bracket.

events.title: New Year Squads Cup
events.description: Squads Battle Royale to kick off the year. Bring a friend who wants to join the clan.
